svg.data-weight-note: 9 lb (4 kg) in the owner's manual, p. 273; 7.6 lb on the product specifications page; no weight is stated for this model
svg.data-power-input: 100 to 240 VAC, 50/60 Hz, two built-in supplies with automatic failover, two IEC inlets, drawn as C14 from the rear photograph
svg.data-power-consumption: 25 W (specifications page); less than 30 W (owner's manual)
svg.data-storage: 4 GB flash (owner's manual p. 8; the specifications page title reads 4 Gb)
svg.data-serial-pinout: Cisco straight RJ45 (owner's manual pp. 10 and 274): 1 CTS, 2 DSR, 3 RXD, 4 GND, 5 GND, 6 TXD, 7 DTR, 8 RTS
